qc.conflicting_duplicate_timestamps: suspect and no selected wind value

eligibility.time_matched: Good provider QC, finite wind, dated station identity and coordinates, documented 10-m height and 1- or 2-minute sustained duration, within registered window and original track support. Unknown roughness explicitly limits interpretation.
eligibility.peak: Retain sampled maximum as a lower bound unless independent uptime documentation plus coverage >= 0.95 and maximum gap <= two cadence intervals support completeness.
eligibility.missing_cases: Retain every declared station/event with an exclusion reason; never replace a station because of weak winds, outage or poor model scores.
eligibility.high_wind_threshold_definition: 64 kt converted with KNOT_TO_MS; no rounded 33-m/s cutoff.

metrics.primary: Compute RMSE per station/event over eligible report times, average equally across stations within each storm, then equally across storms. Retain baseline-paired changes with identical sample support.
secondary: descriptive peak-time offsets with tie counts and censoring flags
metrics.uncertainty: If intervals are computed, resample storms as clusters with paired candidates, never individual reports. Three storms are insufficient for strong population or tail claims.
metrics.failure_rule: Report absent high-wind subsets and metadata/QC failures as missing with counts, never as zero error or a passing validation.
metrics.no_promotion: No candidate is fitted or selected using this collection.

metadata_rules.selection: Require the unique HOMR station record with dated matching ICAO, WBAN and ASOS platform at event time. Do not take the first search result.
metadata_rules.coordinates: Use the latest applicable dated surface position; preserve all source history. Independently documented wind-tower coordinates are a separate sensitivity.
metadata_rules.provider_id: Verify expected NCEI station ID and event-year contents. Identity corrections require a dated amendment before reading wind values, retaining the original registration.
metadata_rules.height_duration: Obtain station-specific evidence before primary scoring. Do not infer height or uptime from an annual CSV.

access_protocol.current_state: Station winds, completeness and model residuals for these six station/event pairs have not been inspected in this project session. Only public station-identification metadata and existing best-track names/times were consulted.
access_protocol.before_first_wind_access: Verify registration and frozen hashes; record acquisition timestamps and raw file hashes. Any additional model candidates need a dated supplemental code/parameter lock before access, retaining this original protocol.
access_protocol.after_access: Mark collection examined; all future tuning requires a different test collection.
access_protocol.independence: Project-level withholding only; these observations may have informed NHC best tracks. This local timestamp/hash lock is not an externally timestamped preregistration.
